sloka: सा तदा करुणा वाचो विलपंती सुदुःखिता ।वनस्पति गतम् ग्रिध्रम् ददर्श आयत लोचना ॥३-४९-३६॥
transliteration: sā tadā karuṇā vāco vilapaṁtī suduḥkhitā ।vanaspati gatam gridhram dadarśa āyata locanā ॥3-49-36॥

translations.english: If he knows that I am abducted by Yama, the god of death, that mighty, longarmed hero will save me even from there by virtue of his valour.
